No-start.reason: Separate no crank, cranks without firing and starts then dies; electrical testing when no crank. No new URL from brief examples alone.

Battery drain.reason: Repeated-discharge section within existing battery guide, then electrical assessment rather than automatic replacement.

Battery warning.reason: Warning is a charging/electrical task; low-voltage battery replacement only after testing.

Oil pressure.reason: Dedicated warning explanation deferred; urgent warning must follow exact vehicle manual, not oil-change marketing.

Check-engine warning.reason: Warning interpretation and conditional urgency, then diagnostic assessment; cost queries remain commercial.

Misfire / rough idle.reason: Investigate running fault; mechanical repair follows findings. Do not presume ignition component failure.

Overheating.reason: Immediate safety and temperature context; distinct from coolant leak without temperature rise.

Coolant leak.reason: Locate fluid loss; related overheating guide supports urgency, not a claim all leaks cause overheating.

Oil leak.reason: Identify source and severity; distinguish fluid loss from oil-pressure warning.

Smoke.reason: White, blue and black exhaust smoke and engine-bay smoke remain separate observations. No measured generic case for a new page; colour alone does not diagnose.

Transmission symptoms.reason: Jerking, slipping, delayed engagement and warning are distinct contexts within fault assessment; maintenance is separate.

AC cooling / airflow.reason: Cooling output, weak airflow, idle-only and one-side complaints are distinguished; no automatic regas or compressor verdict.

Suspension symptoms.reason: Noise, lean and low ride height are assessment contexts; air suspension only where fitted.

Steering symptoms.reason: Assistance and steering feel; speed-related wheel vibration also supports tyre/suspension assessment.

Brake symptoms.reason: Squeak, grinding, braking vibration and changed pedal feel are not interchangeable; no pad replacement from noise alone.

Screen / head-unit fault.reason: Display/touch symptoms to electrical; head-unit or no-audio task to existing head-unit owner; CUE stays Cadillac.

Camera fault.reason: Power, connection and display checks; repair distinct from unverified generic camera installation.

Soft-close fault.reason: Fault in fitted system, distinct from protected ROX installation and compatibility enquiry.

Power loss / boost.reason: Power loss is not proof of turbo failure; mechanical, fuel and transmission checks depend on findings.

Exhaust noise.reason: Noise/leak assessment, not exhaust modification or tuning.

Tyre / wheel symptoms.reason: Puncture/air loss and speed-related wheel concerns; repair eligibility requires inspection.

Vibration.reason: Broad unspecified shaking cannot choose one system; idle, road speed and braking contexts are separated before referral.

Engine noise.reason: Identify noise conditions and associated warnings; do not invent common component failures.

Electrical symptoms.reason: Circuit/voltage investigation; multiple warnings do not imply multiple failed modules.
